subject.title: Add external event hooks for quota and provider state changes

question: Should CodexBar support opt-in external command hooks as a first-class app, shared-config, and CLI capability after the stable account-key defect is repaired?
rationale: The implementation is substantial and carefully hardened, but persistent user-configured command execution is a product and security-boundary choice that code review cannot authorize.

options.title: Sponsor after repair
options.body: Land the feature after integrating a stable account discriminator while preserving the opt-in, shell-free, and redacted execution boundary.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Limit hooks to configuration and CLI or reduce the supported events before accepting a smaller permanent contract.

options.title: Decline command hooks
options.body: Close the PR and keep CodexBar limited to observability and its existing notification and export surfaces.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair
recommendation.body: Land the feature after integrating a stable account discriminator while preserving the opt-in, shell-free, and redacted execution boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, steipete is the clearest available owner for accepting a new first-class command-execution capability.
